summary: Final state: NOT PUBLISHED_AND_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED — DEFECTIVE_PUBLICATION. Independent public-registry verification of the maintainer's manual npm publication proves both @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 and dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 were published as EMPTY SHELLS with no built code. Registry metadata shows dist.fileCount 2 / unpackedSize 2042 bytes (vision) and 3 files / 6753 bytes (image-mind) instead of the accepted candidate's 15 files (~61 kB) and 9 files (~820 kB incl. lib/cli.js); published shasums d43b11093201bf2004215bf914cf7e98363d48d0 and 550b696f0ac91f6d669b5dde1796dc5df4f3f87c match neither the Batch 018 dry-run artifacts (328f7235bf449be7670f7fea8842ad749fb22276, 7f59073ddfadbffdf0409fcead34deabd7e943cb) nor any built tree. A clean-room exact-version install from https://registry.npmjs.org/ confirms the installed trees contain ONLY package.json/README.md (vision) and package.json/README.md/cordis.patch.yml (image-mind): lib/index.js is absent so @ran-sh/dsh-vision cannot be imported (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND), and lib/cli.js is absent so npm skipped creating the dsh-plugin-image-mind bin shim entirely and `npx --yes dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 --version` fails ('dsh-plugin-image-mind' is not recognized). The public npx lifecycle roundtrip is therefore impossible and was recorded NOT RUN rather than faked; composition/boot smoke could not meaningfully run against a service that cannot load. Metadata that DID come through correctly: both dist-tags moved latest to 0.2.0 via npm's normal publish default (recorded truthfully, not mutated), engines node ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0 on image-mind, bin mapping string and dependencies {@ran-sh/dsh-vision: ^0.2.0, schemastery: ^3.18.0} with zero file:/link:/workspace:/git seams in installed metadata. Zero registry writes, no Git tag, no GitHub Release, no real-Harness touch, no repository mutation outside this Result and the ACTIVE_TASK deletion (git diff --check clean). URGENT maintainer remediation required before any v0.2.0 tag/release authorization: the broken 0.2.0 tarballs must be unpublished per npm policy and republished from a built tree (npm run build first), or superseded by corrected versions, because latest currently serves non-functional packages.

blockers: Published @ran-sh/dsh-vision@0.2.0 (shasum d43b11093201bf2004215bf914cf7e98363d48d0) contains only package.json + README.md: lib/index.js and lib/types are missing, so the service cannot be imported at all.

Published dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0 (shasum 550b696f0ac91f6d669b5dde1796dc5df4f3f87c) contains only cordis.patch.yml + package.json + README.md: lib/cli.js, lib/index.js and lib/client.js are missing, so the advertised bin does not exist, npm creates no .bin shim, and `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0` fails immediately.

Both registries' latest dist-tags point at these defective 0.2.0 tarballs, so default public installs are non-functional right now. Maintainer remediation required before v0.2.0 tag/release: build locally (`npm ci && npm run build` in the repo root), then either unpublish both defective 0.2.0 tarballs within npm policy and republish the built artifacts (verify shasums against a fresh `npm pack` — expected ~15-file/~61 kB vision and 9-file/~820 kB image-mind tarballs matching the accepted candidate content), or cut corrected versions (e.g. 0.2.1) from the same main candidate; afterwards re-run this verification batch to earn PUBLISHED_AND_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED.
notes: Final state declared per contract semantics: PUBLISHED_AND_PUBLICLY_VERIFIED was NOT earned; the truthful outcome is DEFECTIVE_PUBLICATION with status FAIL. Per acceptance criteria, PASS status requires that final state and empty blockers — neither holds.

What survived publication correctly: version fields, dist-tags movement to 0.2.0 (npm default), engines, the bin mapping STRING, dependency specs including @ran-sh/dsh-vision@^0.2.0, peer family, and README/cordis.patch.yml payloads. Only the built lib/** artifacts are missing everywhere.

Likely root cause consistent with all evidence: the manual publishes ran from a checkout without `npm run build` output (or after removing lib/), so npm packed the manifests' non-lib files only. The Batch 020 EOTP block is unrelated to this defect.
No secrets encountered or recorded; all npm output used public unauthenticated-capable views plus one read-only authenticated session for whoami-free flows (whoami was not needed here and not run).
